exam.title: Managing Microsoft Teams
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 administration across identity, groups, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Purview, Defender, networking, devices, external collaboration, apps, meetings, Teams Phone, PowerShell, Graph, reporting and troubleshooting.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Configure and manage a Teams environment
Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams

review.notes: Every July 29, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a Teams/Microsoft 365 object, entitlement, role, identity, policy, media/network, data, application, call flow, evidence, failure, or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover network/QoS/readiness, roles/security/Purview/Defender, group/team/data lifecycle and policy assignment, external/guest/shared-channel/MTO, Teams Rooms/VDI, teams/channels/messaging/apps, meetings/events/Copilot, Teams Phone numbers/resource accounts/auto attendants/queues, reporting/CQD/Call Analytics and client/sign-in/media/AI troubleshooting. All 21 URLs are cataloged: 17 reachable and two O'Reilly plus two Udemy pages automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records 19 hours 1 minute of Learn paths, four-day course, free Practice Assessment and freshness gaps in commercial resources.

findings.title: Private-channel support descriptions disagree
findings.evidence: Platform known issue still says under development; updated developer announcement says supported.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Current network diagnostic listing verified
findings.evidence: Public download exists with a current listing; diagnostic is not a stress tool.
findings.recommendation: Replace generic tool uncertainty with a bounded current link and execution limitation.
findings.resolution: Replace generic tool uncertainty with a bounded current link and execution limitation.

findings.title: QoS classification varies by client
findings.evidence: Source ports and browser/Mac/mobile behavior differ.
findings.recommendation: Add marked media classes and actual-path verification.
findings.resolution: Add marked media classes and actual-path verification.

findings.title: Policy assignment is not last-write-wins
findings.evidence: Direct assignment outranks ranked group assignments; nested membership does not inherit.

findings.title: Granular federation can replace the tenant domain list
findings.evidence: Tenant enablement still gates custom policy.
findings.recommendation: Add user/group domain scope and anonymous/subdomain boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add user/group domain scope and anonymous/subdomain boundaries.

findings.title: Channel removal may leave a separate file share
findings.evidence: Shared channel identity, site membership and file permissions differ.
findings.recommendation: Add residual-access and file-level CA troubleshooting.
findings.resolution: Add residual-access and file-level CA troubleshooting.

findings.title: Room exceptions remain account-wide
findings.evidence: Persistent exception and registration resource exclusion are distinct.
findings.recommendation: Add monitored recovery/provisioning scenario and identity distinction.
findings.resolution: Add monitored recovery/provisioning scenario and identity distinction.

findings.title: Windows legacy optimization has two deadlines
findings.evidence: Support loss precedes unavailability; new-stack failure can render on the VM.
findings.recommendation: Add cohort-specific inventory, pilot lab and follow-ups.
findings.resolution: Add cohort-specific inventory, pilot lab and follow-ups.

findings.title: Unblocked does not imply usable by anyone
findings.evidence: Migrated app audience may remain No one; assignment types differ from Teams policy.

findings.title: Consent survives app management migration
findings.evidence: Availability migration is independent of Graph consent.
findings.recommendation: Add before/after audience and consent evidence.
findings.resolution: Add before/after audience and consent evidence.

findings.title: Current event settings determine policy behavior
findings.evidence: Audience optimization selects event policy behavior; capacity changes interaction.
findings.recommendation: Retain exam distinctions and add current experience boundary.
findings.resolution: Retain exam distinctions and add current experience boundary.

findings.title: Legacy live-event creation is retired
findings.evidence: Existing scheduled events have a separate grace window.
findings.recommendation: Replace new-lab assumptions and schedule grace-period recheck.
findings.resolution: Replace new-lab assumptions and schedule grace-period recheck.

findings.title: Copilot Off default is not a fixed prohibition
findings.evidence: Policy values separate organizer defaults from enforced transcript mode.
findings.recommendation: Add actual-setting, retention and encryption checks.
findings.resolution: Add actual-setting, retention and encryption checks.

findings.title: Resource account license alone does not fund outbound calls
findings.evidence: On-behalf-of calls and callbacks need current route-specific entitlements.
findings.recommendation: Add funding and carrier checks distinct from ordinary user calling.
findings.resolution: Add funding and carrier checks distinct from ordinary user calling.

findings.title: Callback must finish inside the queue timeline
findings.evidence: Eligibility, music, caller action and representative readiness all take time.
findings.recommendation: Add synthetic timeout and margin example.
findings.resolution: Add synthetic timeout and margin example.

findings.title: Telemetry scope and retained detail differ
findings.evidence: Current views distinguish session issues, license retention and event presenter scope.
findings.recommendation: Add denominators, processing delay and evidence limitations.
findings.resolution: Add denominators, processing delay and evidence limitations.

blog_intake.notes: Main article read; selected app-request and Windows room migration exercises. No comments, demos or fleet-wide deployment assumptions.

offline_checks: Ten synthetic capacity, audience, timeline, denominator and catalog assertions; no service or executable diagnostic run.

limitations: Private-channel Workflows availability conflicts in official sources; no broad implementation promise or live delivery validation.
No tenant, app, policy, VDI plugin, room migration, media, flow, event, network test or PSTN lab executed.
Four paid catalog pages blocked; historic metadata qualified. Paid lessons/questions, videos, interactive practice, originality and complete current course coverage unreviewed.
July blog main article and updated connector announcement read; comments/demos not used as authority. Legacy Rooms article is not treated as a full new passwordless migration procedure.
Published October objective text remains future-dated; July accepted snapshots unchanged.
Same-context AI research and repair; independent human review pending.

validation.execution_boundary: Local validation only; no infrastructure lab executed.
